name: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM 2017 (public domain), USGS NAIP imagery (public domain), team race-logger GPS centreline

notes.centre: GPS-driven line moved toward the imagery midpoint by a smooth penalised fit; corner radii within 25 % of the driven line
notes.edges: NAIP asphalt extent per side along the final normals; left/right half-widths differ; profile fractions are piecewise (f<0 scales the left half-width, f>0 the right)
